blocks.p: Eye of the North teaches 50 PvE-only skills, a dozen or so for each of its four peoples, every one the reward of a side quest. This guide assumes the storyline is done: the hubs are open and every chain can start. What is left is the quests below, by people, with the giver, where to find them, and the order a chain forces.
The skills are learned by the character and get stronger with the matching title, so take them as early as you like.

blocks.note: Note: this guide hasn't been fact-checked in game yet, so it may have mistakes.

blocks.p: Twelve skills. The useful ones first: the Fighting Tournament in {area:644} for {skill:2353}, Sif's three hunts from {area:643} for {skill:2358} and {skill:2356}, the Olafsons' Alemoot for {skill:2360}, then Hogni's home in {area:513} for {skill:2355} and the three elite blessings.

steps.t: Talk to Gellir Frostshield in {area:644} and pay the 100 gold entry fee; then Magni the Bison, beside the arena, runs the Norn Fighting Tournament: five rounds and a final, one quest after another, each a one-on-one fight in the arena with your heroes outside. The first win of the final gives the three skills at once; later wins give a Championship Token instead.
Talk to Sif Shadowhunter in {area:643}. Three bosses in {area:513}: Koren Wildrunner, Myish, Lady of the Lake, and Nulfastu, Earthbound.
Sif Shadowhunter in {area:643}, after Worthy Deeds. Whiteout and Avarr the Fallen in {area:546}, then the Fragment of Antiquities at the end of the {area:628}, entered from the north of {area:513}.
Sif Shadowhunter in {area:643}, after Anything You Can Do. Tell her when you're ready and kill the Glacial Griffon she sets on you.

Talk to Olaf Olafson in {area:645} if your character is a woman, to Olrun Olafdottir in {area:553} if a man: the Olafsons' three quests go by sex. Drink, haul three kegs, drink, run the slalom, drink, herd three pigs.
The same Olafson, after the Alemoot: Bear Club for Women, or for Men. Talk about the bear, take the club you're handed and beat the bear with it.
The same Olafson, after the Bear Club. Find the bottomless pit in the north-east of {area:546} and kill Ssissth the leviathan.

Talk to Gunnar Poundfist in the eastern part of {area:644}. Then from {area:645} walk out through {area:553} and north into {area:513}: Hogni Truthseeker's home is in its south-west corner, and talking to him gives the skill. Take his three blessing quests while there.
Hogni Truthseeker in {area:513}. Find the polar bear in {area:546}, take the honey from the branch, then lead the bear at the five young hunters until they run. An elite.
Hogni Truthseeker in {area:513}. In {area:482} enlist the six tundra wolves, then follow them south to the Destroyers and kill the lot. An elite.
Hogni Truthseeker in {area:513}. Into {area:617}, the dungeon off {area:546}, and kill the shadow spawn. An elite. The three blessings can be carried together if you'd rather walk to Hogni once.

blocks.p: Fourteen skills. First the three worth having: {skill:2218} from a treasure map in {area:639}, {skill:2423} from Undrath in {area:643}, {skill:2219} from the Deldrimor camp in the {area:625}; Kilroy's brawling in {area:644} last.

steps.t: Talk to Koris Deeprunner in {area:639}. Four map pieces, each at the end of a run through the Depths from one of the Asura gates.
Talk to Undrath Blastrock in {area:643}. Kill Chieftain Ulgrimar Gnash in the east of {area:513}.
Undrath Blastrock in {area:643}. Find and kill Krak Flamewhip's cavalry patrol in {area:546}.
Talk to Orozar Highstone in the {area:625}, in the Deldrimor camp by the way in from the {area:652}. Ask him when Ural will arrive, then hold the camp against the Stone Summit waves.
Orozar Highstone in the {area:625}, after Attack on Jalis's Camp. Find the Stone Summit camp hidden in the west of {area:513} and kill every dwarf in it.
Talk to High Priest Alkar in the same camp in the {area:625}, or in the {area:652}. Three Destroyer Cores, dropped by Destroyers anywhere.
High Priest Alkar, after Destructive Research. Use his concoction on Destroyers.
Talk to Kilroy Stonekin in {area:644}. Your bar is swapped for brawling skills and you beat a few Norn brawlers.
Kilroy Stonekin in {area:644}, after Punch the Clown. Go down with him into {area:704} and punch your way to Fronis Irontoe. Solo, brass knuckles only.
Kilroy Stonekin in {area:644}, after the Punch-Out. Beat Bjorn Thunderfist in the championship brawl.

blocks.p: Twelve skills. First {skill:2235} and {skill:2420} from Artificer Mullenix in the {area:642}, then {skill:2229} from Sergeant Weststar's chain in the Charr homelands, then the rest of the Vanguard's quests there. The givers out there only talk once you have listened to them: Weststar with his troops outside the {area:650} portal, Vael in the middle of {area:649}.

steps.t: Talk to Artificer Mullenix in the {area:642}. Wipe out the Charr expedition in {area:548}, out of the Eye's back door.
Artificer Mullenix in the {area:642}, after Charr Invaders. Lead the Eye's staff out and smash 20 practice dummies in three minutes.
Artificer Mullenix in the {area:642}, after Practice, Dummy. Defend the Eye against the centaurs with the same staff.
Artificer Mullenix in the {area:642}. Tell him you're ready and duel Knorr Oaken.

Talk to the Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon in {area:647}, out of {area:648}; it speaks only once you have heard Sergeant Weststar's talk to his troops outside the {area:650} portal in {area:649}. Find out what became of Jenn Valefield, Chance Redding and Weststar; it ends at Weststar in {area:651}.

Talk to Sergeant Weststar at the mouth of {area:573} in {area:651}, after Falling Out. Into the dungeon after Rake Blazeclaw, then the Enforcer. Hand in at Captain Langmar, in {area:649} by the Longeye's Ledge portal.
Talk to Sergeant Weststar outside {area:648}, after Falling Out. The captives' cave in {area:647}, the Charr guards, the Flaming Scepter Mages.

Talk to Vael in the middle of {area:649}, out of {area:650}: he offers it only once you have met him there, re-zoned and come back. Shadow Torch Harrowkeeper unseen, eavesdrop, talk to Vael, crash the Charr and Grawl meeting, and bring the intelligence to Captain Langmar by the portal.

spots.name: The Charr camp with the plans

steps.t: Talk to Captain Langmar by the {area:650} portal in {area:649}, after Be Very, Very Quiet... and one more re-zone. Meet Vael at the rendezvous, wait for his diversion, run into the camp and steal the plans, back to Langmar.

Captain Langmar in {area:649}, after Plan A. Meet Vael in {area:651} (from {area:648}), follow him to the hierophant's stronghold, three minutes to poison the food and get out, kill Gharaz the Glutton when it goes wrong, report to Vael.
Talk to Vael in {area:651}, after Forbidden Fruit. Wait for his diversion, rush in and kill Vyrrgis the Pestilent. Hand in at Langmar.
Captain Langmar in {area:649}. Flush out and slay the Titan in {area:651}.

blocks.p: Twelve skills. First {skill:2411} from Blorf in {area:624}, then Kerrsh's Ciphers in {area:641}, {skill:2415} and {skill:2418} among them and {skill:2416} at their end; the four Polymock summons last, from Hoff in {area:640}.

steps.t: Talk to Blorf in {area:624}. Meet Erff in {area:485}, walk him to two settlement sites, and hold off the Destroyers from his work krewe.
Talk to Kerrsh in {area:641}. His Divination points you to the Facet of Creation, in {area:572} next door, at one of a few spots; kill it for its cipher.
Kerrsh in {area:641}, after Melandru's. The Facet of Death, in {area:558} out of {area:638}.
Kerrsh in {area:641}, after Melandru's. The Facet of Destruction.
Kerrsh in {area:641}, after Melandru's. The Facet of Existence, in {area:501} out of {area:640}.
Kerrsh in {area:641}, after Melandru's. The Facet of Illusions.
Kerrsh in {area:641}, once the four above are done. The Facet of Spirit.
Kerrsh in {area:641}, after Kormir's. All six Facets again, in a crater in eastern {area:553}, out of {area:645}.

Talk to Hoff in {area:640}: he hands out three starter Polymock pieces; register them with Denn beside him before anything else (a registered piece is the character's for good). Then Yulma, here in Rata Sum. Each match won is a piece gained.
Hoff in {area:640}. Plurgg plays in {area:624}.
Hoff in {area:640}. Blarp plays in {area:638}.
Hoff in {area:640}. Fonk plays in {area:644}.
Hoff in {area:640}. Grulhammer Silverfist plays in {area:639}.
Hoff in {area:640}. Necromancer Volumandus plays in {area:641}.
Hoff in {area:640}. Dune Teardrinker plays in {area:648}.
Hoff in {area:640}, after the three above. Master Hoff plays here.
